description: Delegates to a sub-iterator: forwards its values, `send()` and `throw()`, and evaluates to its return value (PEP 380).
Resumes a generator and makes the paused `yield` evaluate to `value`; the generator must be primed with `next()` first.
Where a generator's `return value` ends up; `for` loops and `list()` discard it.
Raises `GeneratorExit` at the paused `yield` so `finally` blocks run; it does nothing on a generator that never started.
A `try`/`finally` around the yields runs on exhaustion, on errors, on `close()` and when the generator is garbage collected.
